# Temper

> The open-source control plane for coding agents.

Temper sits above coding agents. It supervises Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode: it measures whether they are making progress, detects stalls and loops, changes strategy, and verifies outcomes. Reflex is the progress detector.

- Site: https://temper.baby
- GitHub: https://github.com/james-see/temper
- License: Apache-2.0
- Author: James Campbell (james@valaclaims.com, https://github.com/james-see)

## Install

```
brew tap james-see/tap && brew install temper
```

```
go install github.com/james-see/temper/cmd/temper@latest
```

## Commands

- `temper` — open the TUI
- `temper run "fix the auth tests"` — supervised run
- `temper run --plain "..."` — no TUI, events on stdout
- `temper inspect <run-id>` — replay the event stream
- `temper config show` — agents, providers, reflex
